nodes.summary: Hong Kong Traditional Chinese (zh-HK) translation of the standalone SVG architecture diagram, showing IvyEngine.exe and the runtime host sharing the GameScene loop, which loads the content project's scene graph, ticks engine systems, and runs scripts from GameScripts.dll.
